title: Multi-region model compliance & degradation simulation for fallback economics
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Goal: produce an evidence-backed simulation and playbook that quantifies contract compliance risk and the economic impact of model degradation + multi-region fallbacks for regulated enterprise customers. This ticket covers research, data collection, simulation harness, a set of deterministic scenarios (latency spikes, regional outage, quantization regression), and a short playbook for sales/SEs describing fallback costs, expected SLO changes, and contractual remediation paths.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Simulation harness runs against production telemetry traces and a synthetic workload and outputs per-scenario cost and latency deltas. 2) Documented playbook with three remediation strategies (traffic steering, model variant degrade, capacity reservation) and expected contractual implications. 3) Dashboard mock and one working dashboard panel showing projected token-cost delta under 4 scenarios. 4) Sign-off from Legal on wording for customer-facing remediation commitments.
notes: Scope excludes on-prem upgrade process; separate ticket will track upgrade orchestration for Private deployments.
Work will reuse runtime traces exported by Observability team (trace export v2).
We plan a two-hour cross-functional sync with Eng reliability and Legal during Cycle planning to confirm scenario definitions.
